name: @freellmapi/monorepo
description: Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible gateway that pools free LLM tiers behind one API key.
author: Sanjay Varma <sanjayvarmacol@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --host"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
